evidence.title: Digi Power X Provides Operations and Financial Update
evidence.excerpt: Digi Power X reports that crews are erecting the building shell of its purpose-built AI data-center campus as the project moves from site and civil work to vertical construction.

reported_physical_work: site and civil work completed or superseded for the active shell scope
metadata.reported_phase_2_online_forecast: end of first fiscal quarter of 2027
metadata.construction_scope: The company directly says construction is progressing, crews are erecting the building shell, and the project is transitioning from site and civil work to vertical construction. This supports one shell lifecycle observation for the active purpose-built campus project. It does not establish shell completion, MEP, energization, commissioning, completion, occupancy, or operation for the active build.
metadata.phase_scope_guardrail: The disclosure gives separate Phase 1 and Phase 2 forecasts but does not assign the observed shell work to one named phase. This narrow record therefore represents one combined active flagship-buildout project and does not manufacture two phase entities or duplicate the lifecycle observation.
metadata.operational_module_guardrail: The separately described ARMS 200 modular unit was already live at the Columbiana facility. It is not the shell being erected, does not make the active flagship build operational, and creates no additional entity, capacity, lifecycle, workload, or operating-model row in this construction-focused record.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: The 40 MW Phase 2 commissioning target, 90 MW fiscal-2027 AI-colocation target, additional 50 MW target, and approximately 10 MW GPU-as-a-Service target are forward-looking and not typed as critical IT, gross facility demand, grid connection, generation nameplate, current load, or measured consumption. They remain non-additive metadata and create no normalized capacity rows.
metadata.timing_guardrail: The December 2026 Phase 1 ready-for-service date and fiscal-Q1 2027 Phase 2 online date are company forecasts. They are not actual milestones, exact normalized target dates, or evidence of commissioning, occupancy, current load, or operation.
metadata.operating_model_scope: The disclosure explicitly describes a Colocation Agreement and fiscal-2027 AI-colocation operations for the active campus build. This supports one future-project colocation observation without identifying the counterparty or proving occupancy or operation.
metadata.workload_scope: The source repeatedly calls the active development a purpose-built AI data-center campus and Tier 3 infrastructure for AI compute. This supports only ai_specialized_unspecified for the future project. It does not establish AI training, AI inference, HPC, installed accelerators, rack density, utilization, model identity, or current compute activity in the shell project.
metadata.role_scope: Digi Power X describes itself as an AI data-center infrastructure operator and says it is executing and funding the purpose-built campus buildout. This supports developer and operator roles for Digi Power X. US Data Centers, the unnamed Colocation Agreement counterparty, lenders, equipment suppliers, and NeoCloudz create no owner, landlord, tenant, user, customer, utility, contractor, or investor role in this narrow record.
metadata.location_scope: The disclosure links capital deployed at the company's Alabama site to year-to-date capital expenditures labeled Columbiana and captions the separate ARMS 200 module at the company's Columbiana, Alabama campus. This supports city-level campus identity only; no street address, parcel, boundary, unique-site proof, normalized coordinate, or geometry is retained.
metadata.site_resolution_guardrail: The named locality and company campus support one logical campus and one active buildout project, but the disclosure does not prove parcel topology, building count, phase-to-building assignment, or a uniquely geolocated physical site. unique_site_counted remains false downstream unless independently resolved.
metadata.energy_guardrail: The source discloses no current electrical load for the shell project, annual energy consumption, measured consumption, generation nameplate tied to the project, PUE, WUE, renewable share, water use, cooling configuration, or emissions. MW outlook figures are not converted into MWh or annual energy.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: The publisher image of the separate operational ARMS 200 module, satellite imagery, aerial imagery, computer vision, and analyst geolocation contribute nothing to the active project's identity, lifecycle, capacity, classification, roles, coordinates, geometry, or site resolution.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction from a public all-rights-reserved company disclosure; captured response bytes, API payload, PDF, response headers, curl telemetry, extracted text, rendered pages, and publisher media are not redistributed.
